description: This file defines the AthenaEngineSpec class, a subclass of BaseEngineSpec, providing configuration and methods specific to Amazon Athena within the Superset project. It includes connection details, time grain expressions, error handling, and utility functions for date/time conversion and URI adjustments.

classes.name: AthenaEngineSpec
classes.description: Provides Athena-specific database engine specifications and utility methods for Superset.

methods.name: convert_dttm
methods.description: Converts a datetime object to an Athena-compatible SQL string based on target type.

methods.name: epoch_to_dttm
methods.description: Returns the Athena SQL expression to convert epoch time to datetime.

methods.name: _mutate_label
methods.description: Converts labels to lowercase, as required by Athena.

methods.name: adjust_engine_params
methods.description: Modifies the SQLAlchemy URI with optional catalog and schema parameters for Athena.

methods.name: get_schema_from_engine_params
methods.description: Retrieves the schema name from the Athena SQLAlchemy URI.
